Solutions Architect — Outside IR35 Contract
Location: London / Hybrid (2 days onsite)
Rate: £650–£750 per day
Duration: 6 months (likely extension)
IR35 Status: Outside IR35

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to join our digital transformation programme at a leading FTSE 100 energy company. You will work closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership to define and deliver cloud-native architecture patterns across our operational technology and enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead architecture design and review for hybrid cloud workloads spanning AWS and Azure
- Define and enforce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and C4 model diagrams
- Drive adoption of cloud-native patterns: microservices, event-driven architecture, API-first design
- Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure architectural governance and non-functional requirements are met
- Champion GenAI/Agentic AI adoption — design RAG architectures and evaluate LLM integration patterns
- Engage with C-suite stakeholders and present technical strategies to non-technical audiences
- Support data platform modernisation initiatives using Snowflake and Databricks
- Mentor senior engineers and build internal architecture capability

Must-Have Requirements:
- 15+ years of enterprise architecture experience
- Deep AWS expertise (EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS, CloudFormation, RDS)
- Proven track record delivering cloud migrations and modernisation programmes
- Strong architecture design skills: microservices, API design (REST/GraphQL), domain-driven design
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation
- Stakeholder management at C-suite level
- TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture framework experience

Nice-to-Have:
- GenAI / LLM integration experience (RAG, LangChain, LangGraph)
- Snowflake or Databricks data platform experience
- SAFe or large-scale Agile delivery experience
- AWS certifications (SAA, SAP)
- Energy sector or regulated industry experience

What We're Looking For:
We need someone who combines deep technical expertise with the commercial acumen to translate business strategy into delivered architecture. You will operate as a trusted advisor to our technology leadership and be hands-on when needed.

Please note: This is a genuine outside-IR35 engagement. You must operate via a limited company. We cannot consider PAYE or umbrella candidates.
